english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who calmly accepts disappointment or hardship without dwelling on it.

examples.english: The report did not win an award, but he was philosophical and said he would try harder next time.
examples.traditional: 份報告冇獲獎，佢都睇得開，仲話下次再努力。
